extraction.Name: Louise Larvine (also Louise Larvine Wright)
extraction.Recorded patent: The receipt was signed April 2, 1920, by the allottee. The patent was recorded September 20, 1924, by C. F. Manson.
extraction.Buyer: Louise Larvine Wright and Charles Wright conveyed the land by deed to John C. Connell for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; separately, contract for deed was entered into between Louise Lavine Wright and A. L. Crilly for $900 ($100 down, $300 on or before October 1, 1924; six cows, one sucking calf, one yearling heifer, one team of mares to be delivered at Rosebud stock yards)
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739705 issued; Southeast quarter section 10, township 40, north of range 33; contract for deed with A. L. Crilly dated September 7, 1924; conveyance to John C. Connell dated September 20, 1924; there is some question about the delivery of some of the animals; reference made to affidavit of Mrs. Wright
